Amy Spencer had been suffering from knee problems leading into the games but nevertheless was able to equal her outdoor 200m best of 23.45 as she won her first round race - the fastest of all the qualifiers.

Now turning to individual performances, in the major worldwide championships, seven Belgravians qualified for the World Athletic Championships; Sean Baldock, Tim Benjamin, Dwain Chambers, (who achieved a silver medal in the 4 x 100 m), Julie Hollman, Rachel King, Shelley Newman and Amy Spencer.

Not to be outdone Amy Spencer won the women's 200m and to prove she is over her injury problems ran close to a season's best. And then Stephen Sharp beat the talented Woodford junior Chris Reynolds in a sprint for the line to make the 1500m another exciting and closely contested race.
Bottom left: Amy Spencer was close to her season's best in winning the 200 metres in 23.65. Bottom right: Last leg of the last race of the day and Sean Baldock clinches another great team win.
